profile.headline: Full-stack Software Developer / Machine Learning Enthusiast
profile.summary: My passion is tackling challenging problems related to cloud technology and computer vision. I constantly research new technology and opportunities and actively practice my coding foundation by solving issues in open-source projects. With good communication skills being one of my strong points, I can perform effectively as part of a team but am also comfortable in the role of an individual contributor. Being disciplined and focused allows me to meet required timelines.

company.name: Pacificwide Business Group

positions.title: Backend and ML Engineer
positions.description:
* Configured video streaming server with UV4L and created Python server to capture video in real-time, developed facial detection and recognition models using OpenCV for User Management services.
* Implemented backend server performing database query and system handling services using Python and React.js.
* Integrated microservices and implemented lock manager on Raspberry Pi to control Servo hardware.

company.name: EyeCU Project - San Jose State University

positions.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Implemented back office for admin using Java, Spring Boot, and RabbitMQ to route supporting request tickets.
* Prepared MySQL for transactional data, Redis for caching, and AWS S3 for media data.
* Delivered EJS-based front store on Node.js server that connected to REST APIs provided via microservices.
* Automated deployment to Kubernetes with CircleCI.

company.name: Apple-Brother Store Project - San Jose State University

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
* Integrated Optimal Blue APIs to implement an extensive query tool, which is embedded on the company website as a compact widget and a detailed search page.
* Created Node.JS backend for automatically generating daily Facebook posts to inform clients about the most
up-to-date Mortgage Rates Update.
* Developed the Cascading Style Sheets (CSS), which gives the entire Mortgage Application site a dynamic look.
* Was responsible for designing, testing, communicating, and growing the application platforms by working closely with representatives from third-party vendors.

company.name: Pacificwide Business Group Inc.

positions.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Automated text extractor on user’s ID card using Microsoft OCR technology, reducing registration time by 60%.
* Built address validation system to translate current coordination to zipcode and vice versa using Geocode API.
* Implemented vaccine site visualization on interactive Google map using Geocode API and CVS APIs.

company.name: VaxTrack Projectc - San Jose State University

positions.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Embedded Google Map to provide a comprehensive map view of available stores.
* Implemented responsive front-end using ReactJS backed by a NodeJS server.
* Used ChartJS to render various statistical metrics in the admin dashboard.

company.name: TinyMarketplace - San Jose State University

positions.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Built crawlers to automatically retrieve raw data from CDC in near real-time.
* Wrote map-reduced jobs to aggregate large amount of raw data to insightful metrics.
* Used ChartJS to render various statistical metrics in the admin dashboard.

company.name: Covid-19 Visualizer - San Jose State University

projects.title: EyeCU Project
projects.description:
An AI-powered entrance security system that grants entry using Face ID and expression ID.
* Trained face/expression recognition model on top of the powerful FaceNet using TensorFlow.
* Designed and implemented backend server for hosting the trained model and performing recognition tasks with NodeJS and ReactJS.
* Implemented the lock manager on Raspberry pi that controls the physical motor.

projects.title: VaxTrack Project
projects.description:
An Android App for Automating Checking Eligibility and Booking Appointments for Covid-19 Vaccines.

* Developed and implemented interactive COVID-19 vaccine appointment booking app during phase 1B, which uses OCR technology to extract users’ identification in real-time for eligibility checking purposes.
* Built address validation system using Google Maps API to pull appointment data from health providers.
* Provided vaccine sites visualization on map using Google Maps SDK for Android and Geocode API.
